mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM shop_orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE i.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PAID'

UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'SHIPPED', carrier = #{carrier}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET carrier = #{carrier}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'SHIPPED'
